questions: Should the distance matrix be symmetric with zeros on the diagonal (pairwise distances between all samples), or should it be distances between each sample and the centroids of the clusters?
What should be the shape of the distance matrix? Should it be (n_samples, n_samples) or (n_samples, centers)?
If plot_path is provided, should the function still display the plot interactively (e.g., plt.show()) before or after saving?
Should the function return the distance matrix before or after generating the plot? Could order affect reproducibility if plotting changes state?
What should happen if plot_path is an empty string? Should it be treated as None (no save) or raise an error?
Should the random_seed parameter be passed to make_blobs only, or also to any other random processes (none here)?
If centers > n_samples, is that allowed? Should it be handled or raise an error?
Should the plot axes have labels, title, or grid? The prompt only specifies axes and color, but not other plot details.
